popup.title: GSOPs 3.0 by CG Nomads
popup.content:
Welcome to GSOPs 3.0: Where Magic Meets Reality.

This release brings support for Houdini 22 and adds several new features: mip-splatting, ML-Sharp compatibility, Slat Bake and Splat Reduce (courtesy of Bailey Tsang and Eyeline). Additionally Splat Light Emitter and Splat Relight are in Early Access! Don't forget to check out the example scenes!

Thank you to our contributors, supporters and Studio Licensees for making this release possible!
